verdict: ROAS holding strong at 4.25x; overdue milestones are being cleared now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $4.25 for every $1 spent, generating $6,113 in revenue on $1,437 in spend — and purchases are up 50% in the most recent 7 days versus the prior 7. Efficiency is holding, not yet accelerating, as daily spend has eased slightly this week without a budget change in place. A cluster of planned deliverables from August and September — including CRM flows, subscribe page rebuilds, and funnel tracking — fell behind schedule and are being prioritized and completed now. Your Google Business Profile saw zero engagement actions for three consecutive days this week after a strong prior run, and we are actively investigating the cause. Expect the overdue buildout items to land before month-end alongside the scheduled October milestones, which should strengthen the full funnel heading into November.
